content.title: Moonlit Sill Loop | Still Cat, Celestial Run and Exact Return
content.summary: A silver fox leaves an observatory sill, crosses a star route and returns. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing all source-specific surfaces.

quick_start.input_format: One nonhuman subject retains exact identity. + The opening sill and moon define the return target. + The spatial expansion follows one visible threshold. + Repeated geometry links room and star world. + The final frame matches the opening position with one small residual glow.
quick_start.recommended_input: A silver fox figurine rests on one blue-lit observatory sill beneath a round moon. The fox leaps through one circular aperture into a star field, retaining ears, tail and silver coat. Fold the star path back through the aperture and return the fox to its exact opening sill pose.

creative_dna.mechanism: 一只可辨黑猫从月夜窗台静止基线出发，穿过室内并跃入星空尺度；月亮、窗框和蓝色光线持续回声，最后回到原窗台完成闭环。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.

invariants.rule: One nonhuman subject retains exact identity.
invariants.purpose: Establishes the baseline identity, object or geography that every later state must preserve.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact baseline rule, later changes cannot be attributed to the same subject, object or place, so the sequence loses its reference state. Removed rule: "One nonhuman subject retains exact identity."

invariants.rule: The opening sill and moon define the return target.
invariants.purpose: Makes the visible trigger precede and explain the first mechanism response.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact trigger rule, the response appears spontaneously and the central cause-and-effect claim is no longer demonstrated. Removed rule: "The opening sill and moon define the return target."

invariants.rule: The spatial expansion follows one visible threshold.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the middle progression registered instead of allowing an unexplained reset.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact progression rule, the middle can jump to a replacement state and the accumulated result is no longer traceable. Removed rule: "The spatial expansion follows one visible threshold."

invariants.rule: Repeated geometry links room and star world.
invariants.purpose: Reconnects the changed or partial state to the established subject and spatial anchor.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact reconnection rule, detail or transformed shots can belong to a different subject or geography and continuity cannot be verified. Removed rule: "Repeated geometry links room and star world."

invariants.rule: The final frame matches the opening position with one small residual glow.
invariants.purpose: Turns the terminal hold into observable proof that the mechanism completed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact terminal-proof rule, the sequence stops on motion alone and never confirms the promised outcome or preserved aftermath. Removed rule: "The final frame matches the opening position with one small residual glow."
